Results.ReviewText: Great unit but the warmer rack is too small.  I purchased unit assuming I could get a second warmer grate to sit next to the current(there even appears to be grooves just for this).  Turns out the offset is not the same and a second grate won’t fit.   Found out the groves are for a Rotisserie unit and not dual purpose.  Sad that Weber didn’t connect the dots on this easy engineering design.  It would have cost nothing to do.  Maybe they could make an accessory rack that would fold when not in use now.   BUT anyways besides this deception and the limited warmer size, I love this thing.  It was the first quality barbecue I’ve owned and know it will last with easy care.
Results.Title: Awesome but has one deceptive flaw

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Not only does this grill cook exceptionally well, it is engineered and built to be a solid unit. When shopping for this, I encountered a common theme among other grill brands. No matter how tight they were bolted together, they would “wiggle” at every seam when shook. Not the Weber! It was if it were welded together out of sufficiently thick steel to not flex AT ALL!  Well worth the money and will recommend to anyone.
Results.Title: Well Engineered and Built Strong

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
